scoring_justification: Recomputing the MD trajectories is infeasible for the lightweight checker. Structural trend checks on the agent's own output files verify the claimed physical relationships.

outputs.description: Water energy per molecule averaged in 0.1 nm z-bins. Scored by checking monotonic decrease with electric field intensity.
Volume-integrated water energy U_NP-volume as a function of z. Scored by verifying that its magnitude is larger at a high-field (z≈3 nm) than at a low-field (z≈21 nm) position.

schema.description: Two column whitespace-separated values: time (ps) and z_coordinate (nm). No header.

outputs.description: Nanoparticle centre‑of‑mass z‑coordinate vs time. Scored by verifying net displacement: final average z > 6 nm (crossed first field transition).

output_contract.notes: All three artifacts are required. The checker performs structural trend checks (monotonicity, threshold crossing, relative magnitude) with tolerances to absorb run-to-run noise. No absolute matching against paper-reported numeric values is required.

steps.description: Water energy per molecule strict monotonic decrease with field intensity (lower energy at higher field).
U_NP-volume magnitude larger at z=3 nm than at z=21 nm by at least 5 kJ/mol.
